schedule.title: Schedule and publish
schedule.intro: Set the time, the place and the capacity, then publish. Publishing makes the session visible to members and opens booking.
schedule.whenHint: In the venue's own time zone, not your device's.
schedule.durationHint: The end time is worked out from this, and you can override it below.
schedule.endsHint: Leave empty to derive it from the duration.
schedule.venuePlaceholder: Choose one of your organisation's venues
schedule.customHint: A one-off venue is not added to your organisation's list.
schedule.capacityHint: Filled in from the venue's capacity; you can change it.
schedule.deadlineHint: Leave empty to use the session's start time.
schedule.languageHint: The language of the room, not of the interface.
schedule.published: Published. Members can see it now.
schedule.publishNote: Once published, members can see the session and book a seat.
schedule.incompleteTitle: Not ready to publish — still missing:
schedule.posterPending: The poster arrives with the designer in a later milestone and does not block publishing today.
schedule.failed: That could not be saved — try again.
schedule.invalid: Check the fields: a date, a time and a duration are required, plus a venue from the list or a one-off venue with a name and an address.

sessions.note: Title, status, level, language, schedule and presenters.

rsvps.title: RSVPs
rsvps.note: Every reservation, with session, member, status, waitlist position and reservation time.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.note: Every check-in across every session, with the manual-mark flag.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.note: Per-session averages — not individual ratings; those are on each session's own attendance report.

points.title: Points
points.note: The full ledger for every member, with source, reason and date.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.note: Serial, member, kind and status for every certificate.

members.title: Members
members.note: Name, email, role and status for every member.
